content: Brock Air Services is a Canadian airline that specializes in charter and medivac operations. It is headquartered in Kingston, Ontario. The airline was established in the year 1978. Brock Air Services provides on-demand air charter services, operating primarily out of Kingston Airport and Brockville Municipal Airport. Additionally, the airline offers air ambulance services under a contractual agreement with Ornge, which is Ontario's air ambulance service provider. Furthermore, Brock Air Services is responsible for managing the operations of the Brockville Municipal Airport.
